sentences.text:
Appearance:
 Shri Nilesh Dave - Advocate for the applicant.
Shri Vinod Thakur - GA appearing on behalf of Advocate  ORDER 1.
They are heard.
Perused the case-diary.

2. This is the applicant's second bail application filed under Section 483 of the Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita,2023 as he is arrested in connection w i t h Crime No.153/2024 registered at Police Station Jeeran, District Neemuch (MP) for offence punishable under Sections 420, 384, 467,
468, 471,201 of IPC/ BNS Act of 2023.
Applicant is in jail since 2/7/2024.
3. His earlier bail appliation was dismissed as withdrawn by the coordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 23/1/2025 passed in MCRC.No.52622/2024.
4. Counsel for the applicant has fairly submitted that out of 26 other cases registered against the applicant only three cases are pending and the other cases have already been disposed of.

5. Counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant is ready to deposit Rs. 2,98,000/-
However, for the purpose, some reasonable time be granted.
It is further submitted that the applicant is in custody since 2/7/2025 and the final conclusion of trial is likely to take sufficient time, and thus, the applicant be released on bail.

6. Counsel for the respondent/State on the other hand has opposed the NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-IND:17464 2 MCRC-27651-2025 prayer.

sentences.text: 7. Having considered the rival submissions, and on perusal of the case diary, and taking note of the undertaking given by counsel for the applicant in this Court that the applicant is ready to deposit the amount of Rs.2,98,000/- the application is hereby allowed with a further direction to make the payment as expeditiously as possible before the trial Court.

This Court is inclined to allow the present petition as the applicant is ready to deposit the amount of Rs.2,98,000/- out of which he is ready to deposit Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh) upfront, i.e, before his release at the time of furnishing the bail bonds and remaining amount of Rs.1,98,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Ninty Eight thousand only) to be deposited by the applicant in three equal instalments of Rs.66,000/-(Rupees Sixty Six thousand only) within a period of 3 months.

8. Accordingly, without reflecting upon the merits of the case, the application filed under Section 483 of the BNSS on behalf of the applicant is hereby allowed, subject to deposit of total sum o f Rs.2,98,000/- by the applicant or any other person on his behalf, out of which, Rs.1,00,000/-
(Rupees One Lakh) upfront before his release i.e. at the time of furnishing the bail bond in a fixed deposit in a nationalized bank and producing the receipt/certificate of the same before the concerned trial Court and rest of Rs.1,98,000/-(Rupees One Lakh and ninty eight thousand )to be deposited by the applicant in 3 equal instalments of Rs.66,000/-(Rupees Sixty Six Thousand only)
within a period of 3 months from the date of his release in a fix deposit in a nationalized bank and producing the receipt/certificate of the same before the concerned trial Court and the said amount shall be subject to the final outcome of the case by the trial Court.

The deposit receipt/certificate so produced by the applicant shall be endorsed by the learned Judge of the lower Court to be,
'furnished towards the bail of the applicant and shall be subject to the final decision of the case by the trial Court'.
9.

It is further directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing a bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty five Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:17464 3 MCRC-27651-2025 Court, to appear before the trial Court on the dates given by the Court.
This bail order shall be subject to furnishing an undertaking that the applicant will deposit the amount respectively as directed above.

It is also directed that the applicants will abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of the Cr.P.C.
10.
Accordingly, the MCRC stands allowed and disposed of. C.c. as per rules.
(SUBODH ABHYANKAR) JUDGE das Shyamsingh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 10 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/104792103/
